class: a whole suite too slow to run inside a run, stopped with no verdict, or narrowed by hand with nothing recorded
caught_by: a change-selected tier runs only the tests the import graph relates to the change, and names where its whole run happens (whole_run). With nothing selected it is not-run (empty-scope): it runs nothing and does not block
missed_by: the whole suite on every task, killed before it finished, or a hand-picked subset nobody could audit

cost.source: not yet measured; first real run
